data.name: Junah
data.gender_notes: Junah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Junahah' which means 'agreeableness' or 'grace'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in reference to Prophet Yunus (Jonah) as a title of honor and respect. The name Junah carries the meaning “Grace, Agreeableness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Junah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, agreeableness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Junah is a beautiful and meaningful Arabic name that carries a rich cultural heritage. It is named after Prophet Yunus (Jonah), one of the most famous prophets in Islamic tradition. The story of Prophet Yunus is well-known in various religious and cultural traditions around the world, including Christianity, where he is referred to as Jonah. The name Junah thus connects the bearer to this rich and widely recognized cultural tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Junah holds great spiritual significance as it is mentioned in the Quran as a title of honor and respect for Prophet Yunus. The Quranic verses in which the name is mentioned emphasize his deep faith and obedience to Allah despite facing hardships and trials. Therefore, the name Junah encourages the bearer to strive for faithfulness and obedience to Allah in the face of difficulties and to seek His grace and forgiveness. It serves as a constant reminder of the Prophet's story and inspires the bearer to emulate his noble character and virtues.
